payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the lower performance on Vikidia-FR compared to Newsela-ES is likely due to the diversity of content in Vikidia-FR and the penalization of incorrect rankings in its limited reading levels.

claims.text: Vikidia-FR has more diverse content compared to Newsela-ES, which has content from the same domain as Newsela-EN, potentially affecting performance.
The ranking metrics penalize Vikidia-FR more severely due to its limited number of reading levels, leading to lower SRC and KTCC scores.
Incorrect rankings in Vikidia-FR can result in a completely reversed list, heavily impacting its performance metrics compared to Newsela-ES.
